verdict.rationale: Granola auto-generates AI meeting summaries that can be shaped with custom templates, and speaker tags attribute speech to named participants, which could support owner assignment. Zapier and the API could push note content into a tracker. However, no document explicitly describes extracting action items with owners or collecting them in a trackable list. A PM in the community built a separate app to turn Granola calls into a kanban to-do list because action items were slipping through, which suggests native tracking is lacking. Missing for 10: explicit documented action-item extraction, owner assignment per item, a native place to collect and track action items across meetings, and hands-on corroboration.
